videoAnalysis.title: Gait Video Capture
videoAnalysis.description: Capture a clear walking sequence for AI-assisted gait analysis.

instructions.title: Before recording
instructions.description: Ensure the patient is ready and the walking area is clear.
items: Position the camera so the patient's full body is visible.
Keep the camera steady during the walking sequence.
Ask the patient to walk naturally along the available path.
Ensure adequate lighting and minimal obstruction.

capture.recordedDescription: Review the captured video before continuing.
capture.cameraDescription: Position the patient and start the camera when ready.

cameraPlaceholder.title: Camera not started
cameraPlaceholder.description: Start the camera to begin the gait capture process.

videoAnalysis.footerNote: The recorded video will be sent to the AI analysis pipeline after backend integration.

errors.cameraAccess: Unable to access the camera. Please allow camera permission and try again.
errors.startCameraFirst: Please start the camera before recording.

xrayAnalysis.title: Knee X-Ray Analysis
xrayAnalysis.description: Upload a suitable knee X-ray for AI-assisted image analysis.

instructions.title: Before uploading
instructions.description: Check that the image is clear and suitable for analysis.
items: Upload a clear knee X-ray image.
Ensure the relevant knee region is clearly visible.
Avoid images with excessive blur or obstruction.
Confirm that the uploaded image belongs to the selected patient.

card.previewDescription: Review the uploaded image before continuing.
card.uploadDescription: Select an image file from the device.

uploadArea.title: Upload knee X-ray
uploadArea.description: Drag and drop an image here, or click to browse your device.

xrayAnalysis.footer: AI-assisted analysis will be performed after backend integration. No diagnostic result is generated on this page.

errors.invalidFile: Please select a valid X-ray image file.
errors.noFile: Please upload a knee X-ray before continuing.
